newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EVC SEES EARNINGS UPTURN IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: EVC SEES EARNINGS UPTURN IN 1997.

text.p: Plastics producer EVC said on Wednesday it expected earnings in 1997 to show an improvement.

"In Western Europe the final quarter of 1996 already showed an improvement in prices and volumes (of PVC). This trend has continued into 1997, which gives reason for positive expectations this year, despite continued pressure on margins," EVC said in a statement.
It said that the PVC industry was seen picking up worldwide as U.S. and Asian markets drove up prices and margins.
While extra production capacity was expected to come on line this would be largely offset by a rise in demand, it said.

"All in all these improvements, together with a continued contribution from the compounds, semi-manufactures and end-products division and a further optimisation of corporate units, is expected to lead to an improved result for EVC in 1997," the company said.
EVC, minority held by ICI and Enichem , earlier reported a 1996 net loss of 25 million guilders.
